## 需求描述 / Description

描述希望新增或改进的功能。

Describe the feature you would like to add or improve.

## 使用场景 / Use case

说明使用场景和要解决的问题。

Explain when you would use this feature and the problem it would solve.

## 期望方案 / Proposed solution

说明你希望 CodexBar 如何实现或呈现这个功能。

Describe how you would like this feature to work or appear in CodexBar.

## 替代方案 / Alternatives considered

如果考虑过其他方案或临时解决办法，请在这里说明。

Describe any alternatives or workarounds you have considered.

## 补充信息 / Additional information

可补充截图、录屏、相关配置、相似产品参考或具体工作流。

You can include screenshots, screen recordings, relevant settings, examples from similar products, or specific workflows that help explain your request.
